detaileddescription.para: Ensures that there is space for at least one more monomial.

xrefdescription.para: : if monomials ever become variable-size, then this might allocate far more than double the memory of the previous vector. The problem is that they might actually take up, say, 128 bytes but the worst case is 1024k. Then if 1000 monomials fit in the previous vector, the next vector will allocate 2 * 1000 * 1024k bytes, which is far more than double what the previous vector did. Make it actually double the bytes.

detaileddescription.para: Like a Monoid::MonoVector, except that references are not invalidated when additional memory must be allocated.
